Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableCollisionTr: Allow zombie-to-zombie impacts to cause balance failures.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableRagdollTrip: Experimental. Uses native ragdoll only if a safe setter is exposed; otherwise falls back to normal knockdown.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableSoftSeparat: Wall- and floor-checked soft separation that gently resolves overlapping zombies. Enabled by default for new worlds.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_GroupPileThrottle: Higher values make a dense pile wait longer before another shared trip attempt.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_HungerDaysToFull: Days for hunger to reach maximum
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_EnableZombieDesicc: Continuous starvation irreversibly advances a neutral desiccation resource.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_DesiccationYearsTo: Only time spent continuously at maximum hunger advances this years-scale timer.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_EnableTerminalWith: At full desiccation, emit the neutral M.O.R.T.I.S. event and apply verified zero health.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_FoodSeekingMinimum: Minimum hunger required to seek custom food
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_FoodSearchRadius_t: Searches registered nearby providers only; it never performs a whole-world scan.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_CollisionRuntimeBa: Higher values react to dense crowds sooner but cost more CPU. Work rotates fairly through loaded zombies.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_MovementRuntimeBat: Higher values check trip hazards sooner but cost more CPU. Work rotates fairly through loaded zombies.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableProneTrips_: Allow supported prone living entities to act as trip obstacles.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableCorpseTrips: Allow corpse obstacles to trigger balance checks while zombies move.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableRandomTrips: Allow movement-based random balance checks without a collision obstacle.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableStairTrips_: Allow stair movement to trigger balance checks.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableLungeTrips_: Allow lunge transitions to trigger balance checks.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnablePlayerColli: Allow player collisions to trigger zombie balance checks.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableShoveDomino: Allow a shove to propagate through nearby tracked targets behind the first target.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_EnableStompRepair: Observe finished stomps and search for a missed nearby target. This option does not itself apply replacement damage.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_GlobalTripChanceM: Scale base trip chances across causes. 1 keeps profile values; impact, penetration and other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_RandomTripChanceM: Scale the base chance of random movement trips. 1 keeps the profile value.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_PlayerCollisionTr: Base chance used for player collision trips, from 0 to 1. Global and other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_ShoveDominoMaxCha: Maximum additional targets in a shove chain. 0 prevents propagation beyond the first target.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_ShoveDominoImpuls: Fraction of shove impulse retained at each additional target. 0 stops propagation; 1 retains the full impulse.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_StompRepairRange_: Maximum nearby target search distance, in world tiles, when a stomp finished without a registered hit.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_SoftSeparationStr: Scale overlap corrections before the per-axis correction limit. 0 applies no displacement.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_SoftSeparationMax: Maximum correction on each horizontal axis per resolution pass, in world tiles. Wall and floor checks still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_TripCooldownMulti: Scale per-zombie trip and attempt cooldowns. Higher values space checks further apart; 0 removes these cooldowns.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_EnableZombieHunger: Enable automatic zombie hunger advancement and registered food seeking. Existing stored hunger is not erased when disabled.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_HungerDaysToFull_t: In-game days needed to increase hunger from 0 to 1 without feeding. Higher values slow hunger gain.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_FoodSeekingMinimum: Minimum hunger from 0 to 1 before custom food seeking. Existing vanilla targets take priority.
Sandbox_MORTISSystems_FoodValueMultiplie: Scale hunger relief quoted by transactional food providers. 0 prevents automatic source consumption; it does not remove stored food.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_CollisionTripChan: Scale the base chance of zombie collision trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_ProneTripChanceMu: Scale the base chance of prone-entity trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_CorpseTripChanceM: Scale the base chance of corpse trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_StairTripChanceMu: Scale the base chance of stair trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_LungeTripChanceMu: Scale the base chance of lunge trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
Sandbox_MORTISPhysical_ShoveTripChanceMu: Scale the base chance of shove and shove-chain trips. 1 keeps the profile value; other balance modifiers still apply.
